title: Official PlayStation Used Game Instructional Video
summary: A short, deadpan Sony instructional video from E3 2013 showing how to 'share' a PS4 game by physically handing the disc to a friend. It was Sony's jab at Microsoft's planned restrictions on used games and game sharing for the Xbox One.
why: HN cites it as a famously effective piece of marketing and as Sony's clearest public stance on used games versus Microsoft's.

quote.text: Sony released this tutorial years ago in response to Microsoft making it harder to share Xbox games with your friends
